articles.title: From drone flight to sounding rocket
articles.summary: A drone carrying an unusual payload recently took to the skies above ESTEC, the European Space Agency’s technical centre in the Netherlands, marking the first test flight of a student-developed radar retroreflector technology.

articles.title: SMOS salinity could offer early indicator of El Niño
articles.summary: As the Pacific Ocean moves into an El Niño phase, scientists are monitoring changes in sea-surface temperature, but also sea-surface salinity – which is another key indicator of this phenomenon.

articles.title: Live coverage: SpaceX to launch classified payload for National Reconnaissance Office
articles.summary: The NROL-95 mission will be the third payload for the National Reconnaissance Office launched under the National Security Space Launch Phase 2 procurement. Liftoff from pad 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is scheduled for 3:09 a.m. EDT (0709 UTC).

articles.summary:
